verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers extract_rules (CSS-selector based structured extraction) and ai_query (AI-driven extraction), which let developers get structured data, but there is no evidence of accepting a formal JSON Schema definition that the API validates/conforms output to — extract_rules is a custom stringified JSON of selectors, not a schema spec. missing for 10: explicit JSON Schema input support, schema validation/conformance guarantee, examples of schema-driven structured output.
